constraints.description: Only committed source transactions publish, in source order, with schema-qualified routing, ordered composite keys and canonical typed values.

validation.validation_method: owned live PostgreSQL 17 and Iggy CRUD, rollback, multi-row, composite-key and typed-value scenarios

constraints.description: Applied WAL progress advances only after every event in a source commit is durably accepted; restart replay uses stable event identity without loss.

validation.validation_method: injected post-publish crash, slot LSN observation, restart and broker deduplication scenario

constraints.description: Unsupported types, inadequate identity, poison values, missing old keys, schema drift and unchanged TOAST are explicit and cannot be skipped under a checkpoint.

validation.validation_method: live enrollment/poison/schema scenarios and focused transaction tests

constraints.description: Gateway and deployment require a stable source epoch and explicit server-owned enrollment against an explicit publication.

validation.validation_method: gateway config tests, catalog validation and deployment documentation review

constraints.description: Focused Rust tests, pedantic clippy, formatting, diff hygiene, file size, strict OpenSpec and independent adversarial review pass locally.

validation.validation_method: recorded local quality and review matrix

global_rules: Runtime tests execute locally; CI results are not evidence.
Source receipts bind every candidate implementation and fixture file by SHA-256.
The fixture owns and removes every PostgreSQL and Iggy resource it creates.
c008 does not claim delivery of the later entity-watch, SDK, operations or release gates.
termination_conditions: Independent review has no unresolved critical or warning finding.
